messages:
leo: FYI customer reported Console preview caps != runtime caps after staged flag apply. stepping through telemetry now.
asha: Likely telemetry freshness. Preview uses cohort samples; runtime uses live counters.
mike: Proposal: return confidence_score + optional shadow_run diff in preview API. Shadow_run = what runtime WOULD do if flag applied.
leo: Shadow sounds perfect for ops, but heavy. Limit to internal users and rate-limit.
tara: Backend fallback: prefer 7d EWMA (alpha=0.18) if recent samples missing > 10m, mark confidence down. Also expose `confidence_band_pct`.
asha: API sketch: GET /config/preview?flag=F1&window=7d&shadow=true&include_confidence=true
mike: Console: show pill "Confidence: 0.42 (Low)" and a CTA "Run shadow diff" (if permitted). When confidence<0.25 show banner: "Preview uncertain; runtime may differ".
leo: Tests: unit for EWMA, integration mocking delayed telemetry, e2e for UI pill. Owners: @asha backend, @mike console, @leo tests.
deploy-bot: Planned canary: preview-confidence-v1 -> 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z -> 10% orgs. Monitoring: preview_shadow_mismatch_rate and preview_confidence_gauge.
asha: I'll open PR tonight and gate behind flag.
mike: I'll add UI copy + tooltip with formula.
leo: thanks all, follow up in PR comments with test links.
notes: short thread on adding confidence scores + shadow-run preview API, EWMA fallback, UI pill, tests, canary
